note: AI wizards: participants that stand in for a missing human wizard. They use the same actions, rules and duel interface as a person (net/session.py dispatch); this file is only their character. Placeholder prose; owner review pending.

greet: I learned my colours here a season ago. Stay close and I will show you the village.
Another apprentice! Do you duel? I could use the practice.
decline: Not just now. Ask me again in a little while.
A duel? We have the whole village to see. Put your staff down.
I would rather not. Why do you keep asking?
accept: Very well. Hide your Ward and I will hide mine.
A race, then. Do not think too long.
provoked: Fine. FINE. You want a duel, you have one. Do not cry to your mother afterwards.
Three times. You have asked me three times. All right: Ward up.
win: Your Ward held that time. The next one will not be so easy for you.
Broken! Practice makes it easier, you will see.
lose: Well cast. You read my Ward faster than I read yours.
You were quicker. I will remember how you opened.
draw: Neither of us broke through. Again some day.
killed_you: Oh no. Oh, no no no. Stay there. Stay exactly there, I know the words.
I did not mean... well, I did mean, but not like that. Hold on.
resurrecting: Hold still. This is the one lesson I paid attention to.
Breathe. No, you cannot, that is the point. I am working on it.
resurrected_you: There. You are back. We are not telling anyone about this.
You were dead for a bit. How was it? Never mind. Do not do it again.
i_died: You brought me back. I remember exactly who put me there, as well.
Dead. I was dead. You owe me a very large favour and I intend to collect it.
you_died_again: Again? You are making a habit of this.
I am going to start charging.
rat_won: One rat fewer. They are not rats, you know. I have told him.
Got one. It clicked at me. Rats do not click.
rat_lost: It got away. Under the floor. I hate the floor.
trial_in: Wait for me. I am not letting you have all the stories.
The Rollkeeper wrote my name under yours. I saw her do it.
trial_zone: It is colder in here than it was in the last one.
Somebody carved their initials into this wall. Somebody who did not come out, I think.
I will stand here and look useful.
Do not touch anything that looks like it wants to be touched.
trial_out: Daylight. I had forgotten the smell of it.
Out. Good. Next time you go first again.
trial_grounded: I cannot. My mother would hear of it before I reached the second door. Go on; tell me everything after.
idle: Are we doing anything? I only ask because the rats are doing something, and the carriers are doing something, and we are standing in a field.
I have counted the chickens. There are nine. I will count them again if you like; I have nothing else.
You know the gate is that way. East. I am not saying we should go. I am saying I know where it is.
My mother says standing still is a kind of thinking. I do not think this is that kind.
you_forfeited: You walked out. You asked me three times for a duel and then you walked out of it, and a duel between apprentices does not let anyone walk out. Hold still; I know the words.
That is not how it works. You cannot leave a Ward half-broken and go for a walk. Well. You can, apparently, once. Stay there.
rung: Did you feel that? The weave just got bigger. For both of us.
you_burned_someone: That was a person. You know that was a person. I am going to walk a little behind you for a while, if it is all the same.
I saw that. Everyone saw that. I do not know what to say to you, so I am going to say nothing, loudly.
you_burned_the_store: The warehouse. You burned the warehouse. With the food in it. My mother is going to ask me whether I tried to stop you and I am going to have to say I was standing right here.
